params.caption:
🎮 GTA 6's launch day stats are absolutely bonkers.

New data from Circana's Player Engagement Tracker shows that on GTA 6's launch day (November 19), 61% of all active US PlayStation 5 players and 56% of active Xbox players worldwide were playing GTA 6.

PS5 players averaged 513 minutes in the game that day — over 8.5 hours — while Xbox players averaged 494 minutes, around 8.25 hours. Analyst Mat Piscatella called the numbers "absolutely bonkers."

🕒 Published: 15:02 GMT+3, November 22, 2026

📰 Sources: Eurogamer, Circana Player Engagement Tracker

👥 x.com/RockstarGames

💬 Did you spend 8+ hours in GTA 6 on launch day? Tell us your playtime below!
